Payout of 17 July is short ₹4,084.00.
The bank credited ₹2,57,817.49 against an expected ₹2,61,901.49. 18 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with chargeback cb_00005 of ₹4,084.00, raised 16 July. The gateway debits a disputed amount when it receives the dispute, but books it against the cycle in which the dispute is later confirmed, so the two can fall in different payouts.
Suggested action: confirm chargeback cb_00005 against this payout and record the dispute in the books. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- cb_00005 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
